message_1_subject: Steering committee: scheduling & prep — FinIntegrate + Redwood
message_1_body:
Hi Anil,

Thanks again for the time earlier — great conversation and good alignment on the goals for the pilot. Per our discussion, next immediate step is a short steering committee / exec sponsor meeting so we can: confirm success criteria, align the procurement/legal path, and agree a mutual action plan with milestones.

Proposed draft agenda (30-45 min):
- Quick intros + roles
- Business outcomes and success criteria (economic buyer)
- Security/compliance ask list + evidence needed (SOC 2, data residency, audit logs)
- Procurement & contracting timeline (MSA + SOW)
- Next steps / owners

Could you confirm the right exec sponsor for FinIntegrate to attend, and the procurement/legal contacts we should loop in? I cc'd Laura and Rachel from our side (Laura will run the steering call; Rachel will cover onboarding/CS implications).

I can be flexible next week — some windows that work for our execs:
- Tue 6/15 10:30-11:15 PT
- Wed 6/16 9:00-10:00 PT or 2:00-3:00 PT
- Fri 6/18 12:00-1:00 PT or 3:00-3:45 PT

I've attached a short steering deck and a mutual action plan template to help structure the call.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments referenced: Redwood_Steering_Committee_Deck_v2.pdf, FinIntegrate_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx

message_2_body:
Marissa — thanks, this is perfect.

Quick answers:
- Exec sponsor will be me (VOPE). I’ll also bring our Head of Product for context.
- Procurement: procurement@fintegrate.com (cc'd).
- Legal: legal@fintegrate.com (cc'd).

Security: we’ll need SOC 2 Type II report and confirmation on retention/audit log capabilities. If you have an architecture diagram or an evidence packet you typically share with customers, please include it in the drive link.

Timing: Fri 6/18 3:00pm ET works best for us (that should be 12:00pm PT). I see you suggested 3:00 PT as well; can you confirm the timezone for that slot?

Also, procurement will want a high-level pricing summary and an early view of typical SOW items so they can map budget cycles.

Thanks — look forward to the deck.

—Anil
VP of Engineering, FinIntegrate
anil@fintegrate.com

3) Requested items for FinIntegrate (to help us prepare):

- Procurement contact + brief on preferred contracting cadence (we have procurement@cc'd).

4) Agenda we’ll send as calendar invite (we’ll keep it tight — 30 min preferred):
- 5 min intros
- 10 min business & success criteria (Anil / exec sponsor)

message_4_subject: Re: Steering committee: scheduling & prep — FinIntegrate + Redwood
message_4_body:
Hi Marissa / Anil,

Procurement here — Friday 6/18 3:00pm ET works for us. Please include a pricing summary (T-shirt sizing + expected term) and a sample MSA or high-level contract terms (we prefer to do redlines in parallel with the steering meeting cadence). Our legal lead (legal@fintegrate.com) will do an initial pass once we have a sample.

Quick list of procurement/contract items we usually need:
- High-level pricing (pilot vs production)
- Term length + termination/cancellation language
- Data ownership & usage rights
- Indemnity / liability caps
- SLAs (uptime / latency) if applicable

We’ll accept a DocuSign for the initial statements but will route the MSA through our system for redlines.

Thanks,
FinIntegrate Procurement
procurement@fintegrate.com
